footer.label: About Kithwall
footer.tagline: Kithwall is free, open source and funded by donations. No ads. No tracking.
landing.title: Your people. Your space. Sealed.
landing.lede: A private social network for your family, your friends and the circles you belong to. Everything you share is encrypted on your device, so nobody can read it — not even us.
landing.ctaNote: Free forever. No phone number, no email needed, no password to remember.
landing.p1Body: Posts, photos, messages, names and reactions are encrypted on your device before they leave it. We only ever store sealed data.
landing.p2Body: No advertisers, no analytics, no data brokers. Nothing about you is for sale, because there is no one to sell it to.
landing.p3Body: A chronological feed from people you know, no public like counts, and a clear “you're all caught up”. No algorithm deciding what you see.
landing.p4Body: No phone number, no contact upload, email optional. We keep logs short and ask only for what Kithwall needs to work.
landing.p5Body: Disappearing messages on, read receipts off, your profile visible only to your connections. Relax any of it whenever you like.
landing.p6Body: Open-source code, one-tap export, verifiable safety numbers, and a live page showing exactly what our server knows about you.
landing.s1Body: Warm, Minimal or Bold — in light or dark. Change it any time.
landing.s2Body: Unlock with your face, fingerprint or screen lock. Your keys are made on your device. There's no password.
landing.s3Body: Share a link or a QR code with the people you actually know. We never upload your contacts.
landing.stylesBody: Three styles, each with a light and a dark version. Pick one when you join; switch whenever you like.
landing.donateBody: Kithwall is free for everyone, with no paid tier and no paywall. It runs on donations from the people who use it. Donations open at launch.

join.styleBody: Choose how Kithwall looks. You can change this any time in Settings.
join.nameBody: Your name is encrypted and only shown to people you connect with.
join.nameHint: Use the name your friends and family know you by.
join.passkeyBody: A passkey is how you'll get into Kithwall. It lives on this device and opens with your face, your fingerprint or your screen lock — the same way you unlock your phone.
join.passkeyPoint1: No password to remember, type or have stolen
join.passkeyPoint2: Your encryption keys are created on this device and sealed with your passkey
join.passkeyPoint3: No email or phone number needed
join.phraseWhy: Your passphrase unlocks your account and protects your encryption keys. Pick a few unusual words that only you would think of.
join.phraseWhyDevice: This device can't use a passkey to protect your encryption keys, so you'll use a passphrase instead. Pick a few unusual words that only you would think of.
join.phraseWarning: We can't reset your passphrase — we never see it. After sign-up you'll be able to save a recovery key, just in case.
join.closed: New sign-ups are paused for a little while. Please try again later.
join.peopleBody: Kithwall is better with your people. Share your invite link or QR code with family and friends — we never upload your contacts.
handle.invalid: Use 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers or dots.
handle.taken: That handle is taken. Try another one.
handle.reserved: That handle is reserved. Try another one.
handle.checkFailed: Couldn't check right now. You can still continue.
passphrase.addWords: Add a few more uncommon words.
invite.soon: Personal invite links and your QR code arrive soon.

invite.shareText: Join me on Kithwall — a private space for the people we actually know.
signin.title: Welcome back
signin.body: Sign in with the passkey you created on this or another device.
signin.legacyBody: For accounts created before Kithwall 2. Your posts, photos and connections are all still here.
signin.legacyFailed: We couldn't sign you in. Check your email and password and try again.
signin.mfaBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Kithwall.
signin.mfaWrong: That code didn't work. Check the time on your phone and try again.
signin.mfaFailed: Signed in, but your keys couldn't be unlocked. Please sign in again.
signin.upgradeBody: Next time, sign in with your face, fingerprint or screen lock instead of your password.
signin.upgradePoint: Your password keeps working until you decide otherwise
unlock.title: Kithwall is locked
unlock.body: Your posts and messages are sealed on this device. Unlock to open them.
unlock.bodyNamed: Welcome back, {name}. Your posts and messages are sealed on this device — unlock to open them.
unlock.keep: Keep me signed in on this device
unlock.keepHint: Only on a device you don't share with anyone.
unlock.wrongPassword: That password isn't right. Please try again.

errors.handle_invalid: Handles use 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers or dots.

errors.passkey_unsupported: This device or browser can't use passkeys. You can use a passphrase instead.
errors.prf_unsupported: This passkey can't protect your encryption keys on this device. Use a passphrase instead, or try another device.
errors.no_account_for_passkey: We couldn't find an account for that passkey. Check you picked the right one, or create a new account.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach Kithwall. Check your connection and try again.
errors.weak_passphrase: That passphrase is too easy to guess. Try a few more uncommon words.
errors.wrong_passphrase: That handle and passphrase don't match.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.mfa_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
errors.last_unlock_method: This is your only way to unlock Kithwall. Save your recovery key first, then you can remove it.
errors.signups_closed: New sign-ups are paused for a little while. Please try again later.
home.title: Home
home.emptyTitle: Your feed is quiet — for now
home.emptyBody: Posts from your connections and circles will appear here, newest first. No algorithm, no ads, and a clear end when you're all caught up.
home.sealedBody: Everything here is encrypted on your device. Kithwall's servers only ever see sealed data.
home.peopleBody: Kithwall is for the people you actually know. Invite a few to get started.
circles.description: Family, friends and the groups you belong to.
circles.emptyBody: Family, college friends, the neighbourhood — each circle will have its own feed, chat, albums and events.
messages.description: End-to-end encrypted chats with your people.
messages.emptyTitle: New Messages are on the way
messages.emptyBody: Private 1:1 and group chats, voice notes and calls — all end-to-end encrypted. Your existing conversations are safe in the meantime.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceBody: Choose a style and whether Kithwall is light, dark or follows your device. Saved on this device.
settings.languageNote: Translations are new and being reviewed by native speakers. Spotted something odd? Let us know.
settings.classicNote: Opens the classic settings for now
nudge.recoveryBody: If you lose this device, your recovery key is the only way back into your sealed posts and messages. It takes a minute.
nudge.pushBody: Notifications say who did what — never what anyone wrote.
nudge.pushFailed: Couldn't turn on notifications. Check your browser settings.
nudge.pushIos: On iPhone and iPad, add Kithwall to your Home Screen first, then open it from there.
